pushback_logged.audit_response: Skipped flagging — ADR-0192 line 95-97 explicitly PERMITS pgvector as the ≤10M-vector tenant fallback. The audit rule must be 'pgvector + (billion|hyperscaler|primary|at-scale)' co-occurrence, not pgvector standalone. Implemented as the pgvector_at_scale pattern.
